issues.message: Missing 'role' field to distinguish between Student, Group Admin, and Platform Administrator user roles as defined in requirements
Missing unique constraint on (note_id, user_id) to enforce one rating per user per note as stated in assumptions
No explicit non-functional requirements defined for performance, security, scalability, availability, or response times
Missing 'avatar_url' field but design shows user avatars throughout the application (Profile Header, Message Bubbles, etc.)
Missing 'verification_token' and 'token_expiry' fields needed for email verification flow mentioned in F1 acceptance criteria
Missing 'file_size' column for storage management and display purposes (AWS S3 cost tracking)
Missing 'updated_at' timestamp fields for audit trail and change tracking (best practice for data integrity)
Missing 'last_login' timestamp for user activity tracking and analytics
No specification for message attachment support mentioned in design (Group Chat screen shows plus icon for attachments)
Missing 'attachment_url' field to support file attachments in group chat as suggested by design

required_fixes: Add 'role' VARCHAR(50) field to users table with values: 'student', 'group_admin', 'platform_admin', default 'student'
Add unique constraint on note_ratings table: UNIQUE(note_id, user_id) to prevent duplicate ratings
Add 'avatar_url' VARCHAR(500) nullable field to users table for profile pictures
Add 'verification_token' VARCHAR(255) nullable and 'token_expiry' TIMESTAMP nullable to users table for email verification
Define non-functional requirements including: response time targets (e.g., <2s page load), concurrent user capacity, data retention policies, security standards (OWASP), and uptime SLA
recommendations: Add 'updated_at' TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP to all tables for comprehensive audit trails and change tracking
Add 'file_size' BIGINT field to study_notes table to track storage usage and display file sizes to users
Add 'last_login' TIMESTAMP to users table for user activity analytics and security monitoring
Consider adding 'attachment_url' VARCHAR(500) nullable to group_messages table to support file sharing in chat as indicated by design
Add database-level cascading delete rules for foreign keys to maintain referential integrity when users or groups are deleted
Consider adding 'is_deleted' BOOLEAN soft delete flags instead of hard deletes for data recovery and compliance
Add rate limiting specifications to requirements for API endpoints (e.g., max uploads per day, max messages per minute)
Define data backup and disaster recovery requirements in NFRs (e.g., daily backups, 99.9% uptime)
Consider adding indexes on frequently filtered columns like study_notes.average_rating and study_groups.is_active for query performance
Add password policy requirements to technical requirements (minimum length, complexity, expiration)
